steps.action: Reply to a conversation the owner has just changed so the desk may no longer see it, or that is gone
user_sees: A red line at the top; the list reloads without it
must_not: 'Reply sent.'

steps.action: Open the page with the internet off
user_sees: A red line and 'Try again'
must_not: A blank page

start: Front desk; a conversation the owner already replied to

steps.action: Open Member messages
user_sees: The card under 'Replied' with the owner's line '<owner> replied'
'The member has not opened your reply yet.' or 'The member has read your reply.'
must_not: The owner's reply hidden from the desk on a 'Gym admin' message

steps.action: Tap 'Mark as done', then 'Mark as not done'
user_sees: The card moves to 'Done', then back
must_not: The busy button usable twice at once
The other card's buttons frozen

steps.action: The member writes again while the page is open
user_sees: The card moves to 'Waiting for a reply' when the count changes
must_not: A half-typed reply in another card wiped by the refresh

start: Front desk; members have sent: a complaint to the owner, feedback without a name, a question to one trainer

steps.action: Open Member messages
user_sees: Only messages for 'Gym admin' plus older feedback and questions
The staff note about what is not shown
must_not: A complaint the member did not send to 'Gym admin'
A question sent to one trainer or to the owner only

steps.action: Open the nameless feedback
user_sees: 'A member (name hidden)' and 'The member sent this without their name. You can still reply here.'
must_not: Name, mobile or member link

steps.action: Read the last line
user_sees: 'Messages are deleted 180 days after the last one in a conversation, or as soon as the member leaves the gym.'
must_not: Messages from members who have left

note: Empty for the desk while the owner has messages must read as 'No messages yet…', not an error
Message heads 'Today' / 'Yesterday' in India time
Desk and owner replying at once; typed reply lost on leaving
The trainer note goes through t() but the staff note does not
Long staff note and wrapped chips on a phone
Older messages with no recipient follow the old rule (desk reads feedback, not complaints)
Member sees who replied; owner's panel shows the desk's reply

start: Staff person with the Trainer tick signed in; a member asked this trainer a workout question; More menu row 'Member questions' with a count

steps.action: Tap 'Member questions'
user_sees: Title 'Member questions'
'Waiting for your reply (1)'
must_not: Questions sent only to another trainer or only to the owner
The not-allowed message for a ticked trainer

steps.action: Read the card
user_sees: Member name, pill 'To you', when it was asked, the question
must_not: 'To <own name>' in place of 'To you'
Member's payment or plan details on this card

steps.action: Type in 'Your reply'
user_sees: Hint 'Short and clear. The member cannot reply back; they can ask a new question. <n> of 1000 letters'
must_not: More than 1000 letters accepted

steps.action: Tap 'Send reply'
user_sees: 'Sending…'
The card under 'Answered and closed' with '<trainer> replied · Today, …'
The menu count down by one
must_not: Two answers
The member not told
The question still open for other trainers

start: Other entry: the Member messages page as a trainer

steps.action: Tap 'Member messages'
user_sees: 'Feedback and complaints never go to trainers, so they are not shown here. Neither are questions a member sent only to the owner or another trainer.'
Chips All / Questions only
must_not: A Feedback or Complaints chip
Any feedback or complaint card

steps.action: Reply to a question sent 'To: <this trainer>' and tap 'Send reply'
user_sees: 'Reply sent.'
The reply with '<trainer> replied'
must_not: A reply possible on a message the trainer may not see

steps.action: Tap 'Mark as done'
user_sees: The card under 'Done'
must_not: The member's message deleted

start: Trainer on Member questions

steps.action: Tap 'Send reply' on a question another trainer answered a moment ago
user_sees: A red line with the reason; the list reloads and the card shows the other trainer's answer under 'Answered and closed'
must_not: A second answer saved over the first
The typed reply sent to the member

steps.action: Open a question the member took back, and one left 14 days
user_sees: 'The member took this question back.'
'Closed with no reply after 14 days.'
No reply box on either
must_not: A reply sent to a closed question

steps.action: The owner removes the Trainer tick; the trainer opens the page again
user_sees: 'Only trainers and the owner can see questions. Ask the owner to tick you as a trainer.'
must_not: Questions still readable after the tick is gone

steps.action: Open the page on a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Questions need your gym online' and 'Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: A blank page

start: Trainer; questions in every state

steps.action: Open Member questions with nothing asked yet
user_sees: 'No questions yet. Members find "Ask about your workout" on the Gym tab of their app.'
must_not: An error or a zero that looks like a fault

steps.action: A member asks; the trainer opens the page
user_sees: 'Waiting for your reply (1)' and the card
must_not: The new question missing until sign-out

steps.action: Answer it
user_sees: 'Waiting for your reply (0)' with 'No questions are waiting.'
The card under 'Answered and closed'
must_not: A way to edit or take back the answer that the member is not told about
The open count going below zero

steps.action: A trainer who has since left was the one asked
user_sees: Pill 'To <name> (no longer a trainer)'
must_not: The question lost or stuck with nobody able to answer

start: Trainer; members have sent feedback, a complaint, a question to another trainer and a question to this trainer

steps.action: Open Member messages
user_sees: Only questions this trainer may read
The trainer note
must_not: Feedback, even without a name
A complaint
A question sent only to the owner or another trainer

steps.action: Open Member questions
user_sees: Questions 'To you' and 'To any trainer or the owner'
must_not: Questions 'To <other trainer>' (only the person picked sees them)

steps.action: A member leaves the gym; open both pages
user_sees: Their questions and messages are gone
must_not: A left member's question still readable

note: Empty state; long question text; Hinglish questions
'Today, 5:42 pm' is India time; the 14-day close
Two trainers answer one 'any trainer' question; a typed reply is lost on leaving
Member's notifications off; the trainer's panel alerts for new questions
Trainers mostly use a phone; long pill 'To <name> (no longer a trainer)'
Questions asked before the owner could answer (R-533) and before recipients (R-586)
The member app shows the answer and who gave it; the owner's panel shows it answered
